_comment: Defaults of live/run_live.py (a CLI flag overrides the matching key). Relative paths resolve against the HEAL repo root. Frame synchronization (fps, wait_sec, camera_tolerance, vicon_max_age, vicon_pose_key) is read from convert_conf, so live frames are assembled with the settings the training data were. Cross-car pair_tolerance_sec, car identity, calibration and the HEAL frame format come from build_inference.py (build_inference_py). ros_master_uri: each car's ROS master, {ip} = that car's ip in calibration/vehicles.json (override one with --master 1=http://<ego-ip>:11311). cameras: HEAL uses front only. pair_wait_sec: how long an ego frame waits for its peer before it is dropped. max_network_lag_sec: extra time messages are kept so a late image still finds its Vicon sample. topics: the front image is read from the compressed topic /qcar/csi_front/compressed (a raw image topic saturates the Wi-Fi); the message type is detected. model_dir, live_dir, output_jsonl: replace <QCAR_LIVE_ROOT> (workspace folder). record_dir: null = do not record. output_jsonl may use {session}. view_bev_range_m: [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax] of the bird's-eye view in motion-capture metres. view_max_hz: redraw cap.
